name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, August 04, 2020 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
SPECIAL NOTICE:
PURSUANT TO GOVERNOR NEWSOM'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-29-20 ISSUED ON MARCH 17, 2020, THIS MEETING WILL BE HELD VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY AND NO PHYSICAL LOCATION FROM WHICH MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC MAY OBSERVE THE MEETING AND OFFER PUBLIC COMMENT WILL BE PROVIDED.
ACCESS TO THE MEETING WILL BE AVAILABLE VIA URL: HTTPS://US02WEB.ZOOM.US/J/82780929915 OR BY CALLING (669) 900-6833 ZOOM MEETING ID: 827 8092 9915
IN ORDER TO EFFECTIVELY ACCOMMODATE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION, PARTICIPANTS ARE ASKED TO PROVIDE THEIR COMMENTS VIA E-MAIL BEFORE 6:00 P.M. ON TUESDAY, AUGUST 4, 2020, TO CCPUBLICCOMMENTS@LOMITACITY.COM. PLEASE INCLUDE THE AGENDA ITEM IN THE SUBJECT LINE. ALL COMMENTS SUBMITTED WILL BE READ INTO THE RECORD UNTIL THE TIME LIMIT OF FIVE MINUTES HAS BEEN REACHED. ALL VOTES TAKEN DURING THIS TELECONFERENCE MEETING WILL BE BY ROLL CALL VOTE, AND THE VOTE WILL BE PUBLICLY REPORTED.
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Invocation – Mayor Pro Tem Waronek
c.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
None
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-g be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Full Reading of Ordinances and that they be Read in Title Only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Approval of the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meetings of July 7, 2020, and July 21, 2020
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item #7b
c.
Approval of Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item #7c
d.
Approval of Traffic Sign Changes on Palos Verdes Drive North
RECOMMENDED ACTION:
1.
Replace 2-foot post with standard post and replace eastbound No Left Turn sign (R3-2) with No Left/No U-Turn sign (R3-18) on center median of Palos Verdes Drive North at a point 625 feet west of west curb line of Rolling Vista Drive.
2.
Install westbound No U-Turn sign (R3-4) on standard post on center median of Palos Verdes Drive North at a point 675 feet west of the west curb line of Rolling Vista Drive.
3.
Replace and relocate eastbound Traffic Signal Ahead signs (W3-3’s) with fluorescent yellow-green (FYG) W3-3’s to center median and south side of Palos Verdes Drive North from a point 625 feet west of the west curb line of Rolling Vista Drive to a point 300 feet west of the west curb line of Rolling Vista Drive (install adjacent to existing “SIGNAL AHEAD” pavement markings).
4.
Replace sign and install standard size post for southbound No Left Turn sign (R3-2) posted on the center median of Palos Verdes Drive North facing the Jack-in-the-Box exit driveway.
5.
Install Right Turn Only signs (R3-5R’s) on the north side of Palos Verdes Drive North at both the drive-thru driveway and main exit driveway for Jack-in-the Box.
Item #7d
e.
Adopt Resolution 2020-25 Accepting a Grant of Easement Deed for Sidewalk Purposes at 25905 Cypress Street
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution 2020-25 delegating authority to execute the Sidewalk Easement Deed at 25905 Cypress Street to the City Manager.
RES 2020-25 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING ACCEPTANCE OF THE SIDEWALK EASEMENT DEED AT 25905 CYPRESS STREET FROM ALLA TITENSKY TO THE CITY, AND FINDING SUCH ACQUISITION EXEMPT FROM CEQA
Item #7e
f.
Adopt Resolution 2020-26, Extending the City's Emergency Measures until September 30, 2020, and Taking Related Actions
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution.
RES 2020-26 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AND AFFIRMING ACTIONS OF THE DIRECTOR OF EMERGENCY SERVICES RELATED TO PARKING CITATIONS, EXTENDING THE CITY'S EMERGENCY MEASURES UNTIL SEPTEMBER 30, 2020, AND TAKING RELATED ACTIONS
Item #7f
g.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Pavement Coatings Co. for the FY 2019-20 Street Improvement Program
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Award a Public Works Agreement to Pavement Coatings Co. in the amount of $414,427.82 for the FY 2019-20 Street Improvement Program; and 2) Approve a contingency of $62,164.17 (15%); and 3) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the Public Works Agreement.
Item #7g
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF CARES ACT CORONAVIRUS RELIEF FUND TO AWARD ADDITIONAL BUSINESS LOANS, EXECUTE AGREEMENTS, AND DISPERSE FUNDS
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community and Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Authorize and approve the applications of 16 of the qualified business applicants for funding through the previously approved CDBG funding; and 2) Authorize the expenditure of an additional $60,000 and direct the City Manager to submit for reimbursement of these funds through the CARES Act Coronavirus Relief Fund to fund the remaining 12 businesses that applied for the City's Small Business Grant Program; and 3) Authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with each applicant; and 4) Authorize the City Manager to disperse funds upon execution of an agreement with each applicant.
Item #8
PUBLIC HEARINGS
9.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF A MODIFICATION TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 294, VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 74138, AND PURCHASE AND SALE OF CITY RIGHT OF WAY FOR PHASE 2 OF A MIXED-USE PROJECT LOCATED AT 24516 NARBONNE AVE
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community and Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct public hearing; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2020-27 approving a Modification to Conditional Use Permit No. 294 and finding the project exempt from CEQA; 3) Adopt Resolution 2020-28 approving Vesting Tentative Tract Map No. 74138; and 4) Approve a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Luigi Schiappa Development in the amount of $43,000 and authorize the City Manager or designee to execute all documents incident to the agreement and to consummate the sale upon fulfillment of the conditions of the agreement.
RES 2020-27 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVING A MODIFICATION TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 294 FOR PHASE 2 OF A MIXED-USE PROJECT CONSISTING OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF 16 RESIDENTIAL UNITS WITH A TOTAL OF 39 PARKING SPACES LOCATED AT 24516 NARBONNE AVE., IN THE D-C, DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE AND FINDING THAT THE PROJECT IS EXEMPT FROM CEQA REQUIREMENTS
Item #9
10.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING URGENCY ORDINANCE 816U EXTENDING THE MORATORIUM ON FORECLOSURES AND RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL EVICTIONS FOR NONPAYMENT OF RENT
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct public hearing; and 2) After City Attorney reads the title, Adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 816U extending the temporary moratorium on foreclosures and residential and commercial evictions for nonpayment of rent during the COVID-19 pandemic; a four-fifths vote of the City Council is required and, if approved, will be retroactively in effect from August 1, 2020, and remain in effect until September 30, 2020.
ORD NO. 816U AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, EXTENDING THE TEMPORARY MORATORIUM ON FORECLOSURES AND EVICTIONS DUE TO THE NONPAYMENT OF RENT BY RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL TENANTS IMPACTED BY THE COVID-19 VIRUS, FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA AND SETTING FORTH THE FACTS CONSTITUTING SUCH URGENCY
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, August 18, 2020, at 6:00 p.m.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: July 31, 2020
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
